description:
Must-Have Magnetic Calendars for Homes and Offices

Custom magnetic calendars combine style and use, making them perfect for refrigerators, lockers, and cabinets. Made from 17 pt. magnets, these calendars can easily stick on metal surfaces while always making the essential dates visible. Their impressive high-gloss UV finish adds durability and a polished look, while standard and custom sizes offer variations your customers can choose from. Ideal as promotional giveaways or personalized gifts, magnetic calendars also keep your brand or message visible throughout the year.

Customize Magnet Calendars With Glossy Finishes and Different Sizes

Stay organized and stylish with our custom magnetic calendars, the perfect addition to your refrigerator, locker, or office file cabinet. Printed on durable 17 pt. magnets, these calendars are designed to stick securely to any magnetic metal surface, making them ideal for refrigerators or as handy planning tools in your workspace.

Each fridge calendar magnet has an impressive high-gloss UV finish, providing a sleek, professional look while protecting against wear and tear. Choose from various sizes to fit your needs, from compact designs to larger, eye-catching options.

Our versatile designs make these perfect for personal or business use. Create real estate calendar magnets to keep your brand top-of-mind for clients, or design recipe calendar magnets to share your favorite dishes while staying on schedule.

Design Magnetic Calendars Tailored to Your Brand

Bring your unique calendar magnet designs to life by making your original artwork and uploading it to UPrinting. You may also use our online design tool to create your calendar designs. Once your artwork is ready, upload your design to UPrinting.com or submit your online artwork for seamless printing. Whether you're creating a promotional calendar magnet for the fridge or a personalized gift, we'll ensure your design stands out with a polished finish.
